description: This file defines the 'Home' component for a note-taking application's front-end, utilizing LightningJS components. It manages state synchronization with a store, renders subcomponents such as navigation, notes list, editor, and empty state, and handles lifecycle events.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the main page of the note app, including navigation, notes list, editor, and empty state handling.

methods.name: _sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the component's state with the global store, updating the notesCount and logging the current count.
